# Paul Jeggels Designs

> Custom hand-shaped surfboards made in Jeffreys Bay, South Africa. Paul Jeggels has over 40 years of shaping experience and has hand-shaped more than 4,000 boards. Every board is shaped by hand — no CNC machines — and built to the individual surfer's height, weight, ability and local wave conditions.

## Key facts

- **Shaper:** Paul Jeggels — master surfboard shaper, 40+ years experience, 4,000+ boards shaped, featured in Zigzag Magazine.
- **Location:** 15 Dageraad Street, Jeffreys Bay, Eastern Cape, 6330, South Africa.
- **Phone:** +27 82 960 9353
- **Email:** info@pauljeggelsdesigns.co.za
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00.
- **Service area:** Jeffreys Bay and all of South Africa (boards shipped nationwide; free pick-up in J-Bay).
- **Board types:** shortboards, fish, hybrids, mid-lengths, longboards, and custom fins.
- **Pricing:** custom surfboards from ~R5,000 to R15,000+; ding repairs from R500.
- **Lead time:** typically 2–4 weeks from first consultation to finished board.
- **Fin systems:** FCS II and Futures both fitted.

## What makes it different

Unlike factory or off-the-rack boards designed for a generic surfer, every Paul Jeggels board is shaped for the specific person who will ride it. Paul asks about your height, weight, fitness, ability, local break and surfing goals, then hand-shapes a board that fits you. He has surfed every break in Jeffreys Bay — Supertubes, Kitchen Windows, Point — for over 40 years.
